_doc: Body tempering (BODY-001): a body-cultivation track that runs alongside qi cultivation and is open to everyone. Stages are reached in order; CharacterData.body_stage counts the stages reached (0 = untempered). Per stage: id, name, description, days (time one tempering session takes), items ({item id: count} consumed), optional min_realm (realm id), bonuses (combat stat fractions max_hp/attack/defense/speed, e.g. 0.1 = +10%; the bonuses of every reached stage add up and scale Combat.stats like a bloodline), injury_resist (fraction added to the character's resistance; every injury-source chance in injuries.json is multiplied by 1 - resistance, capped at max_injury_resist) and risk (base chance that the session injures you; minus (constitution - 10) * risk_per_constitution, clamped to min_risk..max_risk). An injured session still reaches the stage: the pain is the price. You cannot temper while injured. injury_table: [{id (injuries.json), weight}] picks the injury.

stages.name: Copper Skin
stages.description: Beaten with iron rods and soaked in salve until the skin turns hard and coppery.

stages.name: Iron Bone
stages.description: The bones are broken and reset around cold iron powder until they ring like metal.

stages.name: Jade Marrow
stages.description: Spirit crystal and mushroom essence wash the marrow until it glows faintly green.

stages.name: Golden Body
stages.description: Earth-fire and dragon-blood gold forge flesh that turns aside common blades.

stages.name: Indestructible Vajra Body
stages.description: Star silver is beaten into every sinew. Legends say such a body can weather a tribulation bolt.
